label: Content or media business (newsletter, course, directory, niche site)
default_stack: Static site with an RSS feed, sitemap and structured data on GitHub Pages; newsletter on a free tier the owner signs up for (Buttondown, beehiiv); paid tier or course sales through Gumroad or Stripe, off until the owner adds a key.

questions.ask: Who reads it, and what decision does it help them make?
questions.default: The narrowest audience the idea names; the agent writes a one-line reader promise.

questions.ask: Whose name goes on it, and should it sound like you?
questions.default: Published under the business name; plain, sourced, no hype.

questions.ask: How often should something new go out?
questions.default: One sourced article or issue a week.

questions.ask: How should it earn: sponsors, a paid tier, a course, affiliate links?
questions.default: Free first; a sponsor or donation link; affiliate links only with a disclosure on every page.

questions.ask: Do you want to approve each piece before it publishes?
questions.default: Yes for the first ten, then only pieces flagged as sensitive.

owner_setup.what: Create the newsletter account and add its API key as a secret.
owner_setup.why: Sending mail to subscribers is in your name.

owner_setup.what: Buy the domain the agent proposes in BUSINESS.md.
Create the payment or sponsorship account if you chose a paid tier.
Decide whether to trade as yourself or register a company once it earns.
